note: Mutants for K3's changes (launch.py's gated precheck: whoami, the Range check, the record, the scrubbed children, the detached orchestrate child, the scrub after the loop, the redirect handler, the family check; orchestrate.py's gated step and stdin hand-over; host.py's gated-download, pull-states, the price and pod-name fixes; setup/download_models_stage1.py's gated run), in the stage-1 kit's spec form. Run with tests/run_mutants_gated_78b.py (tests/test_gated_78b.py, -x): the baseline first with the same command; a mutant is killed only by a real test failure (pytest exit 1, FAILED lines, no ERROR line); an error, a timeout or a find text not exactly once is INVALID, never a kill. fix-K-gated (verify-K-gated D1, D2, D4, D5, D6) added the FG-m-* mutants and re-targeted K3-m-redirect-keeps-auth to the moved clause. fix-K-gated's second attempt added the FX-m-* mutants (F1: a token value a header cannot carry; http_get's ValueError branch; failure_text's two scrubs, the re-verifier's two survivors). K4a (6 Nov) added the K4-m-* mutants: RV2-1 (TLS verification), RV2-2 (no token fragment), RV2-3 (every redirect code), RV2-4, RV2-5, RV2-9 (the D6 paths by hand), and conftest.py's process-wide layer and fixture (DK-1, DK-2, RV2-6, RV2-7). The runner now also runs tests/test_pp10_guard.py and tests/test_pp10_process_wide.py and refuses a Python without huggingface_hub; run the whole spec under sandbox-exec with outbound IP denied (RV2-6). Round 4b (6 Nov): K4bf-m-* for the security verifier's D1 (the wrapper's sendto, sendmsg and AF_INET6 checks), D2 (the hook under the flag, in a non-main thread, bytes hosts) and D3 (the redirect handler's own https_open); run under sandbox-exec with outbound IP denied. K5 (round 5) added 8 mutants (K5-H-d1-wrapper-skips-dgram ... K5-H-d3-global-unverified-at-call).
